heading: Maggie Bittarelli
whatIsNow: (This is a now page, and if you have your own site, you should make one, too.)
lastUpdated: January 13, 2025, from the Greater Boston Area, MA

updates.heading: Starting a new job soon!
paragraphs: Next week I'll be starting as a fullstack dev with a new company! I'm really looking forward to leveling up my TypeScript and Python skills, working on a new team, and doing some interesting work on some new/different types of challenges.

updates.heading: Time to plant...
paragraphs: It's time to start some seeds. I'm gathering a few tools for this undertaking but will hopefully have some seedlings on their way by the end of the month!

updates.heading: Reading
paragraphs: I'm back in a routine of reading, after having finished the massive 1000+ pages of The Lord of the Rings. I've finished two books this past week and am picking up 'The House in the Cerulean Sea' from the library today.

updates.heading: Feeling upset about a tv show
paragraphs: I know I'm in great company feeling upset about the ending to Squid Game season 2. I started watching the season not knowing if I'd really be so interested, because more and more I find myself steering clear of gratuitous violence in my entertainment, but I found the season to be as compelling as the first one (even if I turned away from the screen a lot). The cliffhanger 'ending' felt jarring to me, like they had suddenly run out of time/ideas/money/something. It was out of place everything that came before it, or rather, I wouldn't have thought negatively about it if it had been followed by something that felt more like an ending to a season.
